title: Researchers take over the Hugging Face account behind the Kokoro AI voice model through an expired domain
summary: Researchers led by Alon Hertz registered hexgrad.com, the domain listed in Kokoro's DONATE.md, and used it to reset the password of the publisher's Hugging Face account. In a local test they altered the model weights in 87 seconds. They did not upload them. Kokoro has nearly 13 million monthly downloads; Hugging Face had not replied, per BleepingComputer.
plain: Researchers showed they could take over the account that publishes a popular AI voice model and could have swapped in tampered files.
exec: Teams that auto-fetch model updates could ingest poisoned weights if a publisher's account or domain is taken over.
action: Pin model revisions by hash, avoid auto-pulling latest weights, and review publisher accounts of models you depend on.

validation.note: BleepingComputer report read in full, citing the researchers; Hugging Face had not responded.

review.note: Compared with BleepingComputer: Hertz, hexgrad.com, 87 seconds, nearly 13M downloads, weights not uploaded, no Hugging Face reply
